title: Sheet-metal multi-part nesting
summary: Pack multiple sheet-metal parts on stock sheets with bottom-left-fill decreasing — driver for multi-part DXF and real quote-able sheet counts.
details:
## What's New

- **`vcad-kernel-sheet::nesting::nest_rectangles`**: BLFD packer with configurable stock size, spacing, edge margin, and 0°/90° rotation. Sorts instances by max-dim descending, places each at the lowest-then-leftmost feasible position, starts a new sheet when none fits. Reports per-sheet utilization and flags oversize parts as unplaceable.
- **`nestSheetMetalParts` WASM binding** + engine helper + `Engine.nestSheetMetalParts(parts, params?)` method.
- **`sheet_metal_nest` MCP tool**: each part is either an explicit footprint or a session `document_id` (footprint inferred from the flat bbox). Returns placements + sheets used + utilization + summary line.

This is the spec's Tier-7 nesting capability arriving early. NFP-based true-shape nesting lands in a later tier; rectangular BLFD covers the bulk of laser-cut parts today.
